name: Card Payment Transaction Details 54
definition: Details of the transaction in the authorisation request in a batch.

CumulativeAmount.name: Cumulative Amount
CumulativeAmount.definition: Contains the updated amount of all authorisations related to the same business transaction.

AmountQualifier.name: Amount Qualifier
AmountQualifier.definition: Qualifies the amount associated with the transaction.

DetailedAmount.name: Detailed Amount
DetailedAmount.definition: Detailed amounts associated with the total amount of transaction.

AuthorisedAmount.name: Authorised Amount
AuthorisedAmount.definition: Amount authorised for the payment transaction.

InvoiceAmount.name: Invoice Amount
InvoiceAmount.definition: Amount of the transaction that will be invoiced to the cardholder.

ValidityDate.name: Validity Date
ValidityDate.definition: Transaction authorisation deadline to complete the related payment.

OnLineReason.name: On Line Reason
OnLineReason.definition: Reason to process an online authorisation.

UnattendedLevelCategory.name: Unattended Level Category
UnattendedLevelCategory.definition: Transaction category level on an unattended POI (Point Of Interaction).

AccountType.name: Account Type
AccountType.definition: Type of cardholder account used for the transaction.

CurrencyConversionResult.name: Currency Conversion Result
CurrencyConversionResult.definition: Result of the currency conversion proposed to the cardholder.

Instalment.name: Instalment
Instalment.definition: Data related to a financial loan (instalment).

Recurring.name: Recurring
Recurring.definition: Data related to a recurring transaction.

AggregationTransaction.name: Aggregation Transaction
AggregationTransaction.definition: Payment transaction with an aggregated amount.

ProductCodeSetIdentification.name: Product Code Set Identification
ProductCodeSetIdentification.definition: Codification used to identify the products.

DeliveryLocation.name: Delivery Location
DeliveryLocation.definition: Location of the delivery, for instance pump number or parking bay.

ReSubmissionCounter.name: Re Submission Counter
ReSubmissionCounter.definition: In case a message is sent after the consumption of goods or service, it indicates the number of times the authorisation has been sent to the Acquirer in order to get an approval.

CompletionSequenceNumber.name: Completion Sequence Number
CompletionSequenceNumber.definition: Total Number of Completion related to the authorisation of this transaction.

CompletionSequenceCounter.name: Completion Sequence Counter
CompletionSequenceCounter.definition: Identification in the Sequence of the Completion related to the authorisation of this transaction.

TotalAuthorisedAmount.name: Total Authorised Amount
TotalAuthorisedAmount.definition: Total Amount authorised for the payment transaction when a sequence of completion is used.

AdditionalInformation.name: Additional Information
AdditionalInformation.definition: Additional information related to the transaction like an Invoice or IndustryData (for example  hospitality, lodging, transportation).

ICCRelatedData.name: ICC Related Data
ICCRelatedData.definition: Data related to an integrated circuit card application.
